description.value: The Juice Truck is a Vancouver-based cold-pressed juice bar and wellness shop with a storefront on West 5th Avenue, not far from popular cycling corridors. It specializes in made-to-order hydraulic cold-pressed juices, high-protein smoothies, and wellness shots using organic produce. Cyclists looking for a nutrient-dense, plant-based refuel stop will find a broad menu ranging from simple celery juice to dense superfood smoothies.
